### GT save function + percentile function 

```{r portal-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(cbbplotR)
library(rlang)

glauber <- readr::read_csv("glauber.csv")

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

# 
make_percentile_gt <- function(
    team,
    player,
    data,
    logo_url    = NULL,
    good_color  = "#C0392B",
    avg_color   = "#95a5a6",
    poor_color  = "#2980B9",
    title       = NULL,
    source_note = NULL,
    table_width = 500
) {
  
  required_cols <- c("section", "stat", "percentile", "value")
  missing_cols  <- setdiff(required_cols, names(data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop("data is missing required columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }
  
  if (any(data$percentile < 0 | data$percentile > 100, na.rm = TRUE)) {
    warning("Some percentile values are outside 0-100. They will render oddly.")
  }
  
  data <- data |>
    dplyr::mutate(.row_order = dplyr::row_number())
  

  logo_html <- if (!is.null(logo_url)) {
    glue::glue(
      "<img src='{logo_url}' ",
      "style='height:45px; width:auto; vertical-align:middle; margin-right:14px;'>"
    )
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  sport_icon_html <- "<img src='https://a3.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=%2Fredesign%2Fassets%2Fimg%2Ficons%2FESPN%2Dicon%2Dbaseball.png'
    style='height:40px; width:auto; vertical-align:middle; margin-left:14px; opacity:0.75;'>"
  
  display_title <- rlang::`%||%`(title, glue::glue("{team}"))
  
  tbl_header_html <- glue::glue(
    "<div style='display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between;'>",
    "<div style='display:flex; align-items:center;'>",
    "{logo_html}",
    "<div>",
    "<span style='font-size:20px; font-weight:bold;'>{display_title}</span><br>",
    "<span style='font-size:12px; color:#555; font-weight:normal;'>{player}</span>",
    "</div>",
    "</div>",
    "{sport_icon_html}",
    "</div><br>"
  )
  
  # ── Column label: "POOR / AVERAGE / GREAT" ───────────────────────────────
  pag_label_html <- glue::glue(
    "<div style='display:flex; justify-content:space-between; ",
    "font-size:10px; padding:0 2px; font-weight:bold; letter-spacing:0.04em;'>",
    "<span style='color:{poor_color};'>▲ POOR</span>",
    "<span style='color:#888;'>AVERAGE</span>",
    "<span style='color:{good_color};'>GREAT ▲</span>",
    "</div>"
  )
  
  # ── Bar renderer ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  render_percentile_bar <- function(x) {
    purrr::map_chr(as.integer(x), function(pct) {
      clr <- dplyr::case_when(
        pct >= 67 ~ good_color,
        pct >= 34 ~ avg_color,
        TRUE      ~ poor_color
      )
      glue::glue(
        "<div style='position:relative; width:100%; height:18px; ",
        "background:#e0e0e0; border-radius:4px; overflow:visible;'>",
        "<div style='width:{pct}%; height:100%; background:{clr}; ",
        "border-radius:4px; position:relative; min-width:4px;'>",
        "<span style='position:absolute; right:-11px; top:-2px; ",
        "background:{clr}; color:white; border-radius:50%; ",
        "width:22px; height:22px; line-height:22px; text-align:center; ",
        "font-size:10px; font-weight:bold; z-index:1; display:inline-block;'>",
        "{pct}",
        "</span>",
        "</div>",
        "</div>"
      )
    })
  }
  
  # ── Build gt table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  tbl <- data |>
    dplyr::arrange(.row_order) |>
    dplyr::select(section, stat, percentile, value) |>
    gt::gt(groupname_col = "section") |>
    gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |>
    gt::cols_label(
      stat       = "",
      percentile = gt::html(pag_label_html),
      value      = ""
    ) |>
    gt::text_transform(
      locations = gt::cells_body(columns = percentile),
      fn        = render_percentile_bar
    ) |>
    gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(tbl_header_html)) |>
    gt::cols_width(
      stat       ~ gt::px(145),
      percentile ~ gt::px(230),
      value      ~ gt::px(65)
    ) |>
    gt::cols_align(columns = stat,       align = "right") |>
    gt::cols_align(columns = percentile, align = "left")  |>
    gt::cols_align(columns = value,      align = "right") |>
    gt::tab_style(
      style = gt::cell_text(weight = "bold", size = gt::px(13)),
      locations = gt::cells_row_groups()
    ) |>
    gt::tab_style(
      style = list(gt::cell_borders(
        sides  = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
        color  = "black",
        weight = gt::px(2)
      )),
      locations = list(
        gt::cells_body(),
        gt::cells_column_labels(),
        gt::cells_row_groups()
      )
    ) |>
    gt::tab_options(
      table.font.size            = gt::px(13),
      heading.align              = "left",
      column_labels.font.weight  = "bold",
      row_group.font.size        = gt::px(13),
      row_group.background.color = "#f0f0f0",
      table.width                = gt::px(table_width)
    )
  
  # ── Conditionally attach source note ─────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(source_note)) {
    tbl <- tbl |>
      gt::tab_source_note(source_note = gt::html(source_note))
  }
  
  tbl
}
```

### Glauber percentile

```{r g-percentile, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

pitching_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  "glauber.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  name_repair    = "minimal"
) |>
  dplyr::rename_with(stringr::str_trim) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      c(`K%`, `BB%`, `K-BB%`, `LOB%`),
      ~ as.numeric(stringr::str_remove(.x, "%"))
    )
  )


pct_rank <- function(x, higher_better = TRUE) {
  pct <- dplyr::percent_rank(x) * 100
  if (!higher_better) pct <- 100 - pct
  as.integer(round(pct))
}

pitching_pct <- pitching_raw |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Results
    pct_era    = pct_rank(ERA,      higher_better = FALSE),
    pct_fip    = pct_rank(FIP,      higher_better = FALSE),
    pct_whip   = pct_rank(WHIP,     higher_better = FALSE),
    # Strikeouts
    pct_kpct   = pct_rank(`K%`,     higher_better = TRUE),
    pct_k9     = pct_rank(`K/9`,    higher_better = TRUE),
    pct_kbb    = pct_rank(`K/BB`,   higher_better = TRUE),
    pct_kbbpct = pct_rank(`K-BB%`,  higher_better = TRUE),
    # Command & Contact
    pct_bbpct  = pct_rank(`BB%`,    higher_better = FALSE),
    pct_hr9    = pct_rank(`HR/9`,   higher_better = FALSE),
    pct_babip  = pct_rank(BABIP,    higher_better = FALSE),
    pct_lob    = pct_rank(`LOB%`,   higher_better = TRUE)
  )

g <- pitching_pct |>
  dplyr::filter(Name == "Caden Glauber")


glauber_data <- tibble::tibble(
  section = c(
    "Results",            "Results",            "Results",
    "Strikeouts & Walks",         "Strikeouts & Walks",         "Strikeouts & Walks",         "Strikeouts & Walks", "Command & Contact",  "Command & Contact",  "Command & Contact",  "Command & Contact"
  ),
  stat = c(
    "ERA",   "FIP",   "WHIP",
    "K%",    "K/9",   "K/BB",  "K-BB%",
    "BB%",   "HR/9",  "BABIP", "LOB%"
  ),
  percentile = c(
    g$pct_era,  g$pct_fip,  g$pct_whip,
    g$pct_kpct, g$pct_k9,   g$pct_kbb,  g$pct_kbbpct,
    g$pct_bbpct, g$pct_hr9, g$pct_babip, g$pct_lob
  ),
  value = c(
    as.character(g$ERA),
    as.character(g$FIP),
    as.character(g$WHIP),
    glue::glue("{g$`K%`}%"),
    as.character(g$`K/9`),
    as.character(g$`K/BB`),
    glue::glue("{g$`K-BB%`}%"),
    glue::glue("{g$`BB%`}%"),
    as.character(g$`HR/9`),
    stringr::str_remove(sprintf("%.3f", g$BABIP), "^0"),
    glue::glue("{g$`LOB%`}%")
  )
)

# run function 
tbl <- make_percentile_gt(
  team        = glue::glue("{g$Name} | North Carolina | RHP <br>NCAA Advanced Percentile Rankings"),
  player      = glue::glue("2026 Season: 22 appearances | 8-0 | 4 Saves | {g$IP} IP <br> UNC is 22-0 in games Glauber has appeared in this season."),
  data        = glauber_data,
  logo_url    = "https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/153.png",
  source_note = "<hr>Percentiles against all qualified NCAA pitchers in dataset<br>
<b>Lower is better:</b> ERA, FIP, WHIP, BB%, HR/9, BABIP<br>
<hr>
    <b>FIP</b>: Fielding Independent Pitching based only on strikeouts, walks, and home runs.<br>
    <b>WHIP</b>: Walks + Hits per Inning Pitched.<br>
<b>BABIP</b>: Batting Average on Balls in Play. Average allowed on contacted balls that stay in the park.<br>
<b>LOB%</b>: Left on Base percentage. Share of baserunners a pitcher strands.<br>
<hr>
<b>Data via fangraphs.com | Table by Chris at Bless your Chart | May 18, 2026</b>"
)

gt_save_crop(
    tbl,
    file = "glauber_percentiles.png",
    whitespace = 40,
    bg = "white"
)

tbl
  
```
